workarounds.note: renderToPdf asks for ten faces, four of which no text uses (the italic of Big Shoulders Display; the italic, SemiBold and SemiBold italic of Spline Sans Mono): the provider answers each with the nearest brand file of the same family

not routed around: the PDF holds ten font programs for the six files, because renderToPdf writes one per requested face; the four stand-ins (one more Big Shoulders Display ExtraBold, three more Spline Sans Mono Regular) are unused copies of 215 to 255 bytes, and the write-up says so

col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, because 1.4.1 paints the band, the openers and the cover from the hex; bodyText.referenceColor restates ink, since references skip the palette and would print the default blue
every design text gives lineHeight as a multiple (1, 1.36, 0.86), never a Dimension
every frontmatter value is quoted: the band prints {title} · {subtitle}, and the PDF takes its title and author from them
'line 3' is glued with U+00A0 in a plain paragraph; the map paragraph, which holds :ref runs, was reworded instead, since U+00A0 still breaks in rich paragraphs

the Do and Don't types keep numberingTemplate '{n}', so the captions read 'Do 1.' and 'Don't 1.': with an empty template 1.4.1 prints 'Do .' before the caption text and 'Do' plus a no-break space for a :ref
